Xiaomi Smart Band 7 AMOLED Display Fitness Tracker (CN Variant)

The Xiaomi Smart Band 7 comes with a 1.62'' AMOLED high-resolution touch display with an always-on mode. The display offers a resolution of 192 x 490 pixels and a pixel density of 326 PPI. Everything is presented in detail at high resolution. It delivers adjustable brightness of up to 500 nits. The Xiaomi Smart Band 7 has the protection of tempered glass with an anti-fingerprint coating. It comes with 100+ band faces for you to choose from according to your mood. The visible area of the Xiaomi Smart Band 7 is approximately 25% larger compared to Mi Smart Band 6. Every UI interface has been redesigned and improved with the key information and numbers standing out to you. In brief, the interfaces are clearer and easier to use.

110+ sports modes & 5ATM Water Resistance

The Xiaomi Smart Band 7 supports 110+ sports modes. A wide variety of sports modes help you keep a track of the burned calories, heart rate changes, and workout durations. It has 5 auto-detection modes: outdoor running, walking, treadmill, rowing machine, and elliptical. The Xiaomi Smart Band 7 comes with 5ATM water resistance. It supports pool swimming, snorkeling, and intelligent recognition of the 4 common swimming styles.

SpO2 Monitoring, Heart Rate Monitoring & Sleep Monitoring

The Xiaomi Smart Band 7 comes with all-day SpO₂ monitoring. It is equipped with High precision 6-axis sensor and a PPG heart rate sensor 6-axis sensor. Xiaomi Smart Band 7 band will vibrate to alert you if your blood oxygen level is too low (<90%) to protect you from potential health risks. It also tracks your heart rate in real-time all day long and delivers precise reviews in easy-to-read graphs. The band will vibrate to alert you when your heart rate falls out of the safe zone. It also keeps track of your sleep (deep sleep, light sleep, REM, and naps).

Magnetic Charging for Extended Battery Life

The Xiaomi Smart Band 7 is powered by a 180mAh battery and it supports magnetic charging. It can last up to 14 days of typical use time and it takes ≤2 hours to be fully charged. The Xiaomi Smart Band 7 comes with 06-months warranty.

Xiaomi Smart Band 8 Pro

The Xiaomi Smart Band 8 Pro is a feature-rich fitness tracker that combines a sleek look with reliable operation at a reasonable price. It has a huge 1.74-inch AMOLED display with a smooth 60Hz refresh rate and up to 600 nits of brightness, making it simple to see in any light. The Xiaomi Smart Band 8 Pro includes extensive health tracking features such as heart rate, SpO2, sleep, stress, and over 150 sports modes, as well as built-in dual-band GPS for precise outdoor workout tracking. With a water resistance rating of 5ATM, it is suitable for swimming and general water exposure. The Xiaomi Smart Band's 289mAh battery provides up to 14 days of use, or approximately 6 days with the always-on display enabled. The Xiaomi Smart Band 8 Pro lacks features such as third-party app support, a speaker, mic, and NFC, but it still provides good value for customers who want to monitor their fitness and health without needing full smartwatch capabilities.

Large 1.74″ AMOLED Display

The 1.74-inch AMOLED display is a notable feature, with bright colors and crisp writing. The 60Hz refresh rate allows for smooth animations and quick touch interactions. The Xiaomi Smart Band 8 Pro screen has a brightness of up to 600 nits, making it easy to see in different lighting circumstances. Additionally, the Always-On Display (AOD) feature is convenient, but it has an influence on battery life.

Your Personal Trainer

Follow the instructional animation on the Xiaomi Smart Band 8 Pro to warm up, interact with your muscles, and quickly enter the workout zone. After exercise, use the animation to stretch your muscles and relieve pain. It monitors your heart rate continuously, provides real-time feedback during exercises, and supports more than 150 fitness activities, including running, cycling, yoga, and strength training. The Xiaomi Smart Band 8 Pro's built-in dual-band GPS lets you leave your phone behind on runs and still map your route correctly. It even nudges you to move when you have been sitting for too long, tracks your stress levels, and provides breathing exercises to help you reset.

Health Monitoring

The Xiaomi Smart Band 8 Pro tracks your heart rate continuously using a 4-channel PPG optical sensor. While resting heart rate values are reliable, there have been occasional variations observed during strenuous activities. Measures blood oxygen saturation levels, providing insights regarding respiratory health. Monitors sleep patterns, including deep, light, and REM stages, to provide users with a complete picture of their sleep quality. Assesses stress levels and provides guided breathing exercises for efficient stress management. The Xiaomi Smart Band 8 Pro also helps female users track their menstrual cycles and predict ovulation windows.

Up to 14-day Battery Life

The Xiaomi Smart Band 8 Pro has a 289mAh battery that can last up to 14 days with average use. Users who enable the Always-On Display option should expect to use their device for about 6 days. Charging is accomplished with a magnetic Pogo pin charger, which takes around 1.5 hours to fully charge.

5ATM Water Resistance

The Xiaomi Smart Band 8 Pro is rated 5 ATM water-resistant, which means it can endure water pressure equivalent to 50 meters in depth. This Xiaomi Smart Band makes it suitable for swimming in pools, showering, and being exposed to rain or splashes. However, it is not intended for high-pressure water activities such as scuba diving, water skiing, or hot showers/saunas, as steam or sudden temperature changes can harm the seals.
